title: Find Well-Formatted Phone Numbers
description:
Write a query to return the `id` and `phone` of every contact whose phone number matches the canonical US format **exactly**.

The canonical format is: **3 digits, a hyphen, 3 digits, a hyphen, 4 digits** — for example `555-123-4567`. No leading or trailing characters are permitted.

Return the result in any order.
hint: `{3}` means exactly three. The pattern must cover the whole string, so anchor it with `^` and `$` — otherwise '555-123-4567x' and 'x555-123-4567' would also match.
outputExplanation:
- `555-123-4567` — 3 digits, hyphen, 3 digits, hyphen, 4 digits. Valid. ✓
- `555.123.4567` — uses dots instead of hyphens. Invalid. ✗
- `5551234567` — no hyphens at all. Invalid. ✗
- `555-123-456` — last group has only 3 digits; exactly 4 are required. Invalid. ✗
- `555-123-45678` — last group has 5 digits; the end anchor rejects it. Invalid. ✗

Only row 1 is returned.
